# ui::FileType

Header: `winui/ui/Pickers.hpp`.

One entry of a picker's type box: a name and the extensions it stands for (".txt"; "*" for everything).

Example: 
```cpp
const ui::FileType images{.name = "Images", .extensions = {".png", ".jpg", ".jpeg"}};
```

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | `std::string` |  | The type box label, UTF-8. |
| `extensions` | `std::vector<std::string>` |  | Each "." plus letters, or "*"; becomes "*.png;*.jpg". |
